name: Interregional Distribution Grid Company of Center and Volga Region, Public Joint Stock Company
summary: Interregional Distribution Grid Company of Center and Volga Region, Public Joint Stock Company, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the transmission and distribution of electricity in Russia. It offers power transmission and distribution services to electric grids located in Vladimir, Ivanovo, Kaluga, Kirov, Nizhny Novgorod, Ryazan, and Tula regions, as well as in the Republic of Mary El and the Republic of Udmurtia. The company also designs, installs, and commissions metering stations for electricity, hot and cold water supply, heat energy, gas, and boiler plants and supporting processing equipment, as well as provides facilities maintenance services; and supplies heat energy. In addition, it offers medical rehabilitation services; physical, healthcare, and spa services; accommodation and catering services; transport and warehouse services; and vehicles repair and maintenance services. The company was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Nizhny Novgorod, Russia. Interregional Distribution Grid Company of Center and Volga Region, Public Joint Stock Company is a subsidiary of Rosseti, Public Joint Stock Company.
